950-1662-2645-3430.description:
Activate Karoo by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{W}{W}{W} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, untapping Karoo
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Fatestitcher.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

4247-6761-7084.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, it and Scouring Swarm trigger.
Resolve the land's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Resolve the Scouring Swarm trigger, untapping it and creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.
4247-6761-7084.notes: If you have seven or more land cards in your graveyard, this combo can create infinite creature tokens if you start it with two or more Scouring Swarms.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2122-6495-6972.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Mindless Automaton.
When Mindless Automaton dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
2122-6495-6972.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

3197-4153-6798--196.description:
Cast Herd Baloth by paying its mana cost.
When Herd Baloth enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Resourceful Defense triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat from step 5.

6012-6797--5--195.notablePrerequisites: At least one persist creature has a +1/+1 counter on it.
6012-6797--5--195.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the persist creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, its persist ability and Reluctant Role Model trigger.
Resolve Reluctant Role Model's ability, putting at least two +1/+1 counters onto the surviving persist creature due to the counter-increasing effect.
If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, remove that and one of the +1/+1 counters from it as a state-based action.
Resolve the persist ability from step 2, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2034-2279-5220-6961-7824.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
2034-2279-5220-6961-7824.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Quintorius triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

338-1818-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-1818-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
The other Hero triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

579-2092-4954.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding {2} due to Mana Reflection.
Activate Silvanus's Invoker by paying {1}, untapping the land and causing it to become an 8/8 Elemental with trample and haste in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Repeat.
579-2092-4954.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may tap and untap any other land(s) you control, and use the mana to activate Agatha of the Vile Cauldron's ability.

1477-4694-7652.easyPrerequisites: Tom, Bert, and William is an artifact.
1477-4694-7652.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Tom, Bert, and William.
When Tom, Bert, and William die, they trigger, returning them from your graveyard to the battlefield as a noncreature artifact.
Because Tom, Bert, and William enter as a noncreature artifact, March of the Machines will then cause Tom, Bert, and William to be a 5/5 artifact creature.
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Repeat.

883-2173-5220-6505.description:
Activate Spore Frog by sacrificing it.
When Spore Frog dies, Mortuary and Ashes of the Abhorrent trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Spore Frog from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Ashes of the Abhorrent trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Spore Frog ability.
Cast Spore Frog from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

2112-2438-6972.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Hound of Griselbrand
When Hound of Griselbrand dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Hound of Griselbrand
When Hound of Griselbrand dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Carrion Feeder abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
2112-2438-6972.notes: If Hound of Griselbrand starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

2034-4907-6556-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying at most {2} due to Temur Battlecrier. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static ability.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

1309-2091-6785.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least ten tapped lands.
1309-2091-6785.description:
Cast Mana Geyser by paying {3}{R}{R}, adding {R} for each tapped land your opponents control.
Cast Devastating Onslaught by paying {4}{R}, creating two token copies of Salvager of Secrets with haste.
When the Salvager of Secrets tokens enter, they trigger, returning Mana Geyser and Devastating Onslaught from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

4772-6575-6774--85.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
When Esper Terra enters the battlefield with four lore counters on it due to Doubling Season and Loading Zone, its fourth chapter ability triggers, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3532-5078-6595-6607.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Lorescale Coatl triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Lyse's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

457-5159-5491-6965.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Mishra triggers, creating a token copy of Worldwalker Helm that is a 4/4 Construct artifact creature with haste named Mishra's Warform, and a Map token.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping a Map, adding {U}.
Activate Mishra's Warform by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, creating a token copy of it and a Map token for each Mishra's Warform and/or Worldwalker Helm you control.
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping two Maps, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat from step 3.
457-5159-5491-6965.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Urza's ability.

2457-4772-5794-6705.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect and two 1/1 Frog creature tokens.
Activate Baylen's first ability twice by tapping the Frog and Insect tokens, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

2073-2103-2707-6504.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Capture of Jingzhou each turn.
2073-2103-2707-6504.description:
If Conjurer's Bauble is in your graveyard, activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Conjurer's Bauble from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Conjurer's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it, putting Capture of Jingzhou onto the bottom of your library from your graveyard, and then causing you to draw Capture of Jingzhou from the bottom of your library due to River Song.
Repeat each turn.

880-2757-3585.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Greensleeves triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the creature token, untapping a basic land.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3168-4770-4875-5613.notablePrerequisites: "Samurai" chosen with Urza's Incubator and Conspiracy.
3168-4770-4875-5613.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0}.
When Whitemane Lion enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2034-2724-3194-3582.description:
Activate Kaya the Inexorable's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, putting a ghostform counter on Wormfang Manta.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wormfang Manta, adding {C}{C}.
When Wormfang Manta dies, its second ability and its ghostform ability trigger.
Resolve the ghostform trigger, returning Wormfang Manta from your graveyard to your hand and creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the second trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Wormfang Manta by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Wormfang Manta's first ability does not trigger due to Hushwing Gryff.
Repeat each turn.

1965-2231-5220.description:
Cast Omarthis either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Omarthis enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Mortuary triggers, putting Omarthis on top of your library from your graveyard.
Repeat.

876-2703-3129-4659.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Myr Propagator.
Activate Myr Propagator by paying {3} and tapping it, creating two token copies of itself.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the tapped Myr Propagator and a Myr Propagator token, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Myr Propagator tokens.

1543-3609.notablePrerequisites:
Magistrate's Scepter has at least one charge counter on it.
You control at least three planeswalkers.
1543-3609.description:
Activate three planeswalkers you control by putting zero loyalty counters on them, putting three charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

3263-4494-4659.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
3263-4494-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Reborn Hero, adding {C}{C}.
Reborn Hero dies, causing you to pay {2} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.

2034-3284-3490.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature you control, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Korvold's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and draw a card.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

2665-4377-4477.notablePrerequisites:
Enough mana available to cast the extra turn spell each turn.
Progenitor Mimic is a copy of Greenwarden of Murasa.
2665-4377-4477.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Greenwarden of Murasa.
When the token Greenwarden of Murasa enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
